rationale: Fixes CSG autosmooth behavior but the underlying autosmooth feature (116749) is absent from HEAD (no `autosmooth` symbol in csg_shape.*), so it must be ported with that chain.
Performance fix for CSG auto smoothing that depends on the missing 116749 feature; large csg_shape.cpp rework only meaningful once autosmooth is present.
Adds new CSG autosmooth (`autosmooth`/`smoothing_angle`) API absent from HEAD; should be ported as a set with its follow-up fixes 119551/119682.
Fixes CSG gizmo collision selection inside CSGCombiners; patch applies cleanly to modules/csg/editor/csg_gizmos.cpp on HEAD.
UBSan correctness fix using put_u32 for unsigned DDS header writes; applies cleanly to modules/dds/image_saver_dds.cpp.
Self-contained addition of R8/R8G8 DDS import support; dds_enums.h/texture_loader_dds.cpp patches apply cleanly on HEAD.
Re-adds area to moved list after area_set_space; maps via fork rebrand (Godot->Foundry paths/classes) and moved_list/area_add_to_moved_list exist in foundry_physics_2d/3d.
TRANSITION_TO_TIME_PREVIOUS_POSITION is used in code but never BIND_ENUM_CONSTANT'd; patch adds the missing binding and applies cleanly.
Adds missing background panel to the audio stream interactive transition editor tree; single-file patch applies cleanly.
Only fails JPEG import on fatal libjpeg errors instead of warnings; applies cleanly to image_loader_libjpeg_turbo.cpp.
Explicitly rejects unsupported CMYK/YCCK JPEG colorspaces to avoid corrupt imports; applies cleanly to image_loader_libjpeg_turbo.cpp.
Adreno workaround inlining integrate_edge_hill in area-lights shaders, but neither lm_area_lights_inc.glsl nor integrate_edge_hill exists on HEAD (4.7 area-lights feature absent).
Corrects bar/beat wording in MP3/Ogg importer docs, but the fork added extra editor-hint lines so the patch no longer applies and needs manual reapply.

Converts GridMap/Replication to upstream EditorDock, but the fork heavily rewrote the dock/workspace model (GridMapEditor still VBoxContainer, own editor_dock_manager) so this needs deliberate adaptation.
Normalizes the returned closest-point normal in NavigationServer3D queries; two-line fix applies cleanly to nav_mesh_queries_3d.cpp.
Makes LocalVector copy ctor explicit engine-wide; HEAD still has implicit ctor and the patch fails (fork renamed navigation server files) so all fork copy sites must be audited.
Switches NoiseTexture2D/3D from raw Threads to WorkerThreadPool; conflicts only on GDCLASS->FOUNDRY_CLASS rebrand but the threading-lifecycle change warrants validation before landing.
Already on HEAD: snapshot_data.cpp already guards both loads with `if (ResourceLoader::exists(path))`.
Already on HEAD: UPNP.xml sample already uses UPNP.UPNP_RESULT_SUCCESS instead of OK.

Replaces per-byte heap read loop with heapSlice in websocket send; maps via rebrand (GodotRuntime->FoundryRuntime, renamed library_foundry_websocket.js) and FoundryRuntime.heapSlice is already used elsewhere.
Fixes disable_xr being ignored on web; trivial config.py change but must be applied after 118780 which introduces the proxy_to_pthread guard it edits.
Disables WebXR when proxy_to_pthread is enabled to avoid a broken web build; config.py patch applies cleanly and is the base for 118805.
Fixes empty ZIP directory entries, but depends on the 115946 Unix-permissions infra (add_directory/directories set/permissioned start_file signature) which is absent from HEAD.
Adds ZIPPacker Unix-permissions/mtime support (add_directory, directories tracking, compat.inc) not present on HEAD; needed as prerequisite for the 120069 fix.
